root_freeze.preimage_rule: registry_preimage.v3: parse JSON; omit root_freeze.payload_refs; sort object keys recursively; preserve array order; encode compact UTF-8 JSON; append exactly one LF; SHA-256 exact bytes

pre_adoption_source.adoption_rule: N00 atomically rebinds N01-N11 to the exact contract bundle, graph, refs, and new epoch; no DAG edge.

prelaunch_gates.claim_impact: exact source-base compile gate supports N11 lease issuance only
exact source-base namespace gate supports N11 lease issuance only
exact source-base standards gate supports N11 lease issuance only

active_records.invalidation_rule: invalidate on any consumed-set intersection or upstream identity change
active_records.rebase_rule: refresh only from a clean lane at a root integration boundary; dirty lanes are never externally rebased
active_records.git_metadata_rule: normalize absolute paths and symlinks, resolve linked-worktree gitdir, and protect .git files, gitdir refs
active_records.overlap_rule: normalize paths, symlinks, and gitdir metadata; fail closed on owned path/symbol/generated/fixture/effect/root overlap
active_records.teardown_retention: retain only unique evidence; remove reproducible worktree state after handoff

retention.command: authorized retention reconciliation of validation_artifacts/review and .codex-worktree home/tmp

issuance_transition.populate: root atomically snapshots exact current diagnostic files and explicit dependency-closed support files before issuing P0-DEBT-REPAIR

record_template.invalidation_rule: invalidate on any consumed-set intersection or upstream identity change
record_template.rebase_rule: refresh only from a clean lane at a root integration boundary; dirty lanes are never externally rebased
record_template.git_metadata_rule: normalize absolute paths and symlinks, resolve linked-worktree gitdir, and protect .git files, gitdir refs
record_template.overlap_rule: normalize paths, symlinks, and gitdir metadata; fail closed on owned path/symbol/generated/fixture/effect/root overlap
record_template.teardown_retention: retain only unique evidence; remove reproducible worktree state after handoff

conditional_reproof.rule: Re-review only when invalidated consumed-set intersection is non-empty.

requires: two byte-identical inventories at final closure

open_decision_defaults.rule: apply each adopted safe default; do not promote a blocked decision claim

installed_journey.fitness: current receipt required; existing stale or null lineage is withheld
installed_journey.cohesion: current journey evidence required; existing stale or contract-only evidence is withheld

execution_policy.scope_overlap_rule: normalize paths/symlinks and gitdir; fail closed on owned path/symbol/generated/fixture/effect/root overlap

teardown_requirements: captured active claim or recovery evidence
remove reproducible state and disposable cache

source_context.rule: Eight refs bind the exact Stage B source set; any byte change invalidates current refs.

consumed.rule: Resolve all eight refs as one full set; never select a stale global consumed set.

finding_policy.collection: one exhaustive meaningful finding set per freeze
finding_policy.deferred: assign nonblocking debt to a named trigger, owner, and claim impact in VERIFICATION_BACKLOG.json
